technical-summary: New serving config qwen27b-tp3-long-iq6r-bf16i8: the IQR-V4 (6-bit) container on TP3 (XTX, XTX, R9700) at 262,144-token sessions with a bf16_i8 cache; the pool pages 993,258 tokens. Registered in the release profiles, generated resolver presets and the resource parity fixture. Smoke: start, one completion, clean stop on bc-radiance-2030.4.0.
user-summary-candidate: IQR-V4 on three cards can run with a 16-bit key / 8-bit value cache: about 993,000 tokens at full session length.
